about: A GitHub Action that shows test results on pull requests.

prs.title: Failing tests are counted even past the annotation limit
prs.broken: Once the limit on annotations was reached, the action stopped reading the test report. A failing test after that point was never seen, and the check passed.
prs.changed: Every test is now counted; only the annotations stop at the limit.
prs.matters: A failing test can't hide behind a passing check.
